notes.title: Endless Update
notes.notes:
Endless Mode is an optional mode that shows up after completing all floors of a dungeon.
How far can you go? 

[b]Changelog[/b]
[list]
[*] Endless Mode
[*] Double click QoL improvements, makes it easier to combine skills faster.
[*] Golden Goblet enable/disable issue fix.
[*] Enchanted Tome buff (-15 % -> -7.5% skill potency)
[*] Tornado nerf (40 -> 30 base damage)
[/list]

notes.title: Korean Language Update
notes.notes:
Thanks to Aramus and his friends (HELLMETT and DAWI), there is now a Korean language option in the demo!

Let me know if you find any issues with the patch, I might have missed something.

Other changes:
[list]
[*] Increased range for Ranger skills
[*] Changed arrow sprites
[*] Minor changes to Dwarf ally (Paladin bonus)
[/list]

notes.title: Relics Update
notes.notes:
Changelog:
[list]
[*] Added relics (20 available in the demo)
[*] Most AoE skills now follow their targets
[*] Meteor, Reap, Tornado starts on cooldown
[*] Skill UI rework
[*] Skill & Classes rebalancing
[*] Dreadspire Keep: 30 floors instead of 20
[*] Some new enemies & some changes for existing ones
[*] Hotkey: Enter to start battle
[*] Various bugfixes
[/list]

Known bugs:
Skills sometimes get stuck when combining (rare bug)

Let me know if you have any suggestions/balance issues or find any bugs!

notes.title: Demo Update #3
notes.notes:
Changelog:
[list]
[*] Added Unit Tooltips, Trait Tooltips, Gold Tooltip
[*] Knight trait reworked. (Now summons a Royal Ranger)
[*] Rogue trait buff
[*] Necromancer trait nerf
[*] Druid Tornado buffed
[*] Multiclass skills
[*] Various enemy unit balancing (Green Witch, Yellow Sentinel, Arch Vampire, Gnolls, etc.)
[*] Various skill balancing
[*] Bugfixes
[/list]
Known bugs:
[list]
[*] Projectiles miss sometimes
[*] In rare cases, friendly units spawn at bottom left corner and causes no enemies to spawn on the floor.
[/list]
Let me know if you find any bugs or have any suggestions!
/ Jim

notes.title: Demo update #2
notes.notes:
Changelog:

[list]
[*] Druid trait bonus reworked
[*] Tutorial dungeon added
[*] Skill combining mechanic reworked (Now you drag and drop to combine).
[*] Widescreen fix
[*] Options Menu, Windowed mode added
[*] Balance changes to many skills and trait bonuses
[*] Various Bugfixes 
[/list]

Feel free to post suggestions and bug reports down below or in the discussions tab.

/ Jim
